description:
A single Instagram reel by URL or shortcode: owner, caption, likes, comments, duration, resolution, audio, cover image and a downloadable MP4 link.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `shortcode`.
Returns: shortcode (string), link (string), media_id (string, nullable), owner_username (string, nullable), caption (string), like_count (integer, nullable), comment_count (integer, nullable), like_and_view_counts_disabled (boolean, nullable), view_count (integer, nullable), taken_at (integer, nullable), taken_at_text (string, nullable), duration_seconds (number, nullable), width (integer, nullable), height (integer, nullable), has_audio (boolean, nullable), audio (object, nullable), thumbnail_url (string, nullable), video_url (string, nullable), video_url_expires_at (string, nullable).

shortcode.description: Reel shortcode; alias used only when url is empty. Example: "DYxz0A8Kinw"

url.description: Reel URL (/reel/, /reels/ and /p/ links work; a bare shortcode also works). Example: "https://www.instagram.com/reel/DYxz0A8Kinw/"

name: instagram_reel
title: Instagram reel
